ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey/black) with approximately 10-15% high-intensity pixels consisting of white scarring and leading-edge barnacle clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark contiguous field across visible lobes; distinct high-contrast white clusters concentrated along the superior leading edges; secondary distribution of white circular pixel clusters (rosettes) localized on the right lobe surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with deep vertical penetration towards the peduncle insertion point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extreme high-amplitude jaggedness on the right lobe trailing edge with at least three major stepped indentations; left lobe trailing edge shows moderate frequency serration.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex trajectory sweeping superiorly; right lobe sweep is significantly modified by non-linear tissue loss on the distal margin.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible constellation of approximately 8-12 white ring-shaped pixel clusters on the lower-to-mid section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe traumatic indentation/amputation marks on the trailing edge of the right lobe creating a saw-tooth profile; heavy barnacle encrustation along the leading edges of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Atypical stepped morphology of the right lobe trailing edge provides a unique geometric signature.
